column1: # CORRESPONDENCE_release_N.tsv: every file of the package under code/, data/ and records/ (release_M's, then the files release_N adds), then
# the Lean sources of lean/StripIII_v2 (from its SCRUBBED_FILES.tsv), then the archived files that do not ship.
# Columns: original sha256 (- for a file with no original), release path (- for a file that does not ship), release sha256, change, twin.
# Change: identical, T, P, T+G, G+P, T+P, T+G+P, G-new, G-new+P, P-new, rerun, rerun-record, original-T, acc2-log and spot, as release_L
# and release_M define them; D: a file whose bytes are a docstring-only edit of its archived original, the same program by AST (the
# record-to-Lean converters), or a comment-only edit, equal to it with every comment removed (the Lean sources); superseded: an
# archived document of release_M that does not ship, with its note; not shipped: an archived file of release_N's record manifests
# that does not ship, with its class (out:tables, out:superseded, out:bookkeeping, out:reports, out:notes), or, as out:pinned-input,
# an archived file outside those manifests that a shipped record of a carried producer pins and that would need a change to ship, or,
# as replaced by lean/StripIII_v2, a Lean source of release_M's tree lean/StripIII_v1, which release_N does not ship.
# Twin: the first other path, in byte order, among all files of the package with the same bytes, or -; for the ten libraries that G
